home.title: Train Your Heart With Artificial Gravity
home.description: The Gaura machine recreates centrifugal force to simulate artificial gravity, providing personalized cardiovascular training as well as support for maintaining muscle and bone mass. Intensity is set by the rotation speed, within the limits set by the machine's software. The machine, initially designed for athletes and medical rehabilitation, will also enable any person, able-bodied or disabled, to maintain their physical activity indefinitely.
home.basedIn: Inspired by space technologies, for better physical fitness

solution.title: Physical Explanation
solution.description: Understanding how centrifugal force transforms cardiovascular training through our innovative Gaura technology.
solution.step1Description: When a person stands upright, Earth's gravity pulls blood into their feet. Similarly, the rotation of our machine creates centrifugal force that drives blood towards the lower limbs.
solution.step2Description: The faster the machine rotates, the higher the centrifugal force. The machine recreates artificial gravity that forces the user's heart and entire cardiovascular system to react to compensate for the blood movement.
solution.step3Description: The Gaura machine recreates cardiovascular effort based on rotation. Thus, cardiac effort can be very finely controlled for rehabilitation, personalized training, or physical activity maintenance.

heartRate.title: Controlled Heart Training
heartRate.description: An individual's heart rate changes according to their activities. Gaura technology stimulates a wide range of BPM and provides precise control over the induced cardiac load.
heartRate.lyingDownDesc: The heart doesn't have to contend with gravity
heartRate.standingUpDesc: The heart works against gravity to deliver blood to the brain
heartRate.trainingDesc: The heart functions as a pump against the artificial gravity generated by our technology

useCases.title: A technology designed for training differently
useCases.description: Our goal: stimulate cardiovascular and muscular activity, even when traditional training is difficult, limited, or impossible. It is designed for people in rehabilitation or with reduced mobility, as well as athletes looking to improve their performance.
useCases.maintainDesc: Some situations make traditional cardiovascular exercise difficult or impossible.
useCases.optimizeDesc: Beyond rehabilitation or fitness maintenance, this technology can also become a complementary sports training tool:
useCases.regularAthletes3: Train in a more targeted and efficient way
useCases.ambition: In addition to maintaining activity and sports optimization, Gaura aims to offer predictive medicine services to anyone, to anticipate cardiac pathologies and contribute to improving everyone's health.

benefits.title: Personalized, efficient, and fast training
benefits.description: 30 to 40 minutes per day are sufficient to achieve significant cardiovascular and muscular benefits, while promoting recovery and physical maintenance. Intensity is set for each person by the rotation speed, within the limits set by the machine's software.
benefits.heartTrainingDesc: Strengthen your cardiovascular system through adapted stimulation and a personalized training program, designed to improve endurance and blood circulation.
benefits.recoveryDesc: Accelerate muscle recovery by promoting better blood circulation in the lower limbs, enabling more efficient elimination of metabolic waste.
benefits.vo2maxDesc: Increase muscle oxygenation capacity and stimulate capillary network development, contributing to improved endurance and physical performance.
benefits.vascularizationDesc: Improve blood flow to lower extremities
benefits.injuriesDesc: Reduce injury risks through better recovery, optimized blood circulation, and support for muscle repair and regeneration processes.
benefits.balanceDesc: Contribute to maintaining body balance and stability by stimulating proprioception mechanisms. Gaura sessions help improve postural control and coordination, essential for mobility and fall prevention.
benefits.muscleDesc: Help preserve muscle mass, especially during periods of reduced mobility, injury, or recovery, by maintaining adapted physiological stimulation.

markets.title: Business Opportunity
markets.description: Targeting both athlete performance and medical rehabilitation markets in the US & Europe.
markets.athleteMarketDesc: Athletes injured, Performance training, Recovery programs
markets.medicalMarketDesc: Quadriplegics, Wheelchair users, Elderly care, Cardiac rehabilitation

cta.description: Join the future of heart health and athletic performance with Gaura's artificial gravity technology.

faq.description: Everything you need to know about Gaura technology and how it can transform cardiovascular training.
faq.stillQuestionsDesc: Our team is here to help. Contact us for more information about Gaura technology.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Gaura, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal and health data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information.
privacy.section1Content: We collect information you provide directly to us, including personal identification information (name, email address), health and medical data (ECG recordings, heart rate data, session history), and account credentials. We also automatically collect device information, usage data, and log files when you use our services.
privacy.section2Content: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, process and complete ECG monitoring sessions, generate health reports and analytics, communicate with you about our services, ensure the security and integrity of our platform, and comply with legal obligations.
privacy.section3Content: Your data is stored securely using industry-standard encryption methods. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Health data is stored in compliance with applicable healthcare data protection regulations.
privacy.section4Content: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information with healthcare providers authorized by you, service providers who assist in our operations, and legal authorities when required by law. All third parties are bound by confidentiality obligations.
privacy.section5Content: You have the right to access your personal data, request correction of inaccurate data, request deletion of your data, object to processing of your data, and request data portability. To exercise these rights, please contact us at the email address provided below.
privacy.section6Content: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to provide our services and fulfill the purposes described in this policy. Health data may be retained longer as required by applicable healthcare regulations.
privacy.section7Content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at:

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: Welcome to Gaura. By accessing or using our services, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. Please read them carefully before using our platform.
terms.section1Content: By creating an account or using Gaura services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.
terms.section2Content: Gaura provides cardiovascular monitoring and training services using artificial gravity technology. Our platform includes ECG monitoring and recording, real-time heart rate analysis, session management and reporting, and health data visualization. Our services are intended for use under appropriate medical supervision.
terms.section3Content: To access our services, you must create an account with accurate and complete information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials, all activities that occur under your account, and notifying us immediately of any unauthorized use. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.
terms.section4Content: Gaura services are not intended to replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult with qualified healthcare professionals before starting any new health regimen. The data and reports provided by our platform are for informational purposes and should be reviewed by medical professionals. In case of medical emergency, contact emergency services immediately.

You must not use our services in any way that violates applicable laws or regulations, infringes on the rights of others, transmits harmful or malicious code, or attempts to gain unauthorized access to our systems.

You may not reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works without our express written permission.
